description.zh:
全球加速实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the GA instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The ID of the backend service instance.

description.zh:
后端服务实例的类型，取值： 

- **EcsInstance**（默认值）：ECS实例

- **SlbInstance**：负载均衡实例
description.en:
The type of the backend service instance. Valid values:

*   **EcsInstance** (default): Elastic Compute Service (ECS)
*   **SlbInstance**: Server Load Balancer (SLB)

title.zh: 查询指定后端服务器绑定的全球加速实例

descriptions.zh: > 该接口仅支持查询带宽独享型实例。
descriptions.en: > You can call this operation to query only dedicated-bandwidth GA instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-server-related-global-acceleration-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --server-id i-12s3sdf0000 --server-type EcsInstance --region cn-hangzhou
